en.title: Zug Government Elections – All Incumbents Re-elected – Laura Dittli with Best Result
en.summary: All members of the Zug cantonal government retained their seats in elections, with no surprises. The left-green alliance again failed to gain representation.

en.title: War in Middle East – Iran Ties Opening of Strait of Hormuz to Conditions
en.summary: Iran has stated it will only open the crucial oil transport route once seven conditions from a prior agreement with the United States are fulfilled.

en.summary: During the German Chancellor's visit to Ukraine, air raid sirens sounded multiple times as he called for an end to the conflict.

stories.title: MELDUNGEN SCHWEIZ - Zuger Regierungswahlen: Alle bisherigen Mitglieder sind wiedergewählt +++ Schweizer Politiker wollen Musks Investitionspläne im Wallis verhindern

en.title: Switzerland Announcements - Zug Government Elections: All Incumbents Re-elected +++ Swiss Politicians Want to Block Musk's Investment Plans in Valais
en.summary: All current members of the Zug cantonal government were re-elected. Swiss politicians are seeking to prevent implementation of Elon Musk's investment plans in the Valais region.

stories.title: Face à la contestation des lycéens, les cours seront suspendus «totalement ou partiellement» lundi dans 400 à 500 établissements français

en.title: Faced with high school student protests, classes will be suspended "totally or partially" Monday in 400 to 500 French schools
en.summary: France's Education Minister announced that classes will be suspended fully or partially Monday in 400 to 500 secondary schools where safety conditions are not met. Twenty-four school buildings have been burned or damaged during the student protests.

stories.title: En France, 24 lycées "saccagés ou incendiés" et des cours toujours suspendus lundi

en.title: In France, 24 secondary schools "vandalized or burned" and classes still suspended Monday
en.summary: The French Education Minister reported that 24 school buildings have been burned or vandalized during secondary school protests. Classes will be fully or partially suspended Monday in 400 to 500 secondary schools.

en.title: LIVE TICKER - Iran War: Another attack on tanker in the Strait of Hormuz +++ Iran sets conditions for ending blockade
en.summary: The United States and Iran have been in a state of war since February 2026 after a ceasefire agreement was ended by Donald Trump in early July. The report covers recent military developments in the conflict.

stories.title: La Lettonie garde son cap pro-européen aux législatives malgré la percée des populistes

en.title: Latvia maintains pro-European course in legislative elections despite populist surge
en.summary: Latvia's pro-European and pro-Ukrainian United List party, led by Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs, won 35.3% of votes in Saturday's legislative elections. The party will need to form a coalition with other groups despite gains by populist and sovereigntist parties.

stories.title: La Lettonie garde son cap pro-européen après les élections du Parlement

en.title: Latvia maintains pro-European course after Parliament elections
en.summary: Latvia's pro-European and pro-Ukrainian United List party, led by outgoing Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs, won Saturday's legislative elections decisively. Despite populist and sovereigntist gains, the country remains oriented toward Western alignment.

stories.title: US and French films sweep board at Zurich Film Festival

en.title: US and French films sweep board at Zurich Film Festival
en.summary: French director Pierre le Gall's film won the Best Feature Film award at the 22nd Zurich Film Festival, while Pete Muller's documentary received the Golden Eye award. The awards ceremony took place at the Zurich Opera House.
